attchmntText: Mallcom (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Mallcom India Ltd filed its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings presentation with BSE and NSE on November 12, 2026. For H1 FY27, operational income was INR 2,528 Mn, a 3.4% decline year-on-year. EBITDA stood at INR 289 Mn with an 11.43% margin, up 93 basis points year-on-year. Net profit was INR 143 Mn, with diluted EPS at INR 22.94. In Q2 FY27, operational income grew 2.9% year-on-year to INR 1,433 Mn. EBITDA margin improved to 10.61%, and net profit was INR 77 Mn with diluted EPS of INR 12.41. The company commenced construction at its Chandipur facility and received the Eastern India Best Employer Award 2026.

attchmntText: Mallcom (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Mallcom India Limited submitted un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, to the BSE and NSE. The Board of Directors considered and approved these standalone and consolidated results, along with the statement of assets and liabilities as at September 30, 2026, and the cash flow statement for the half year ended on that date, during a meeting held on November 12, 2026. The meeting commenced at 03:02 p.m. IST and concluded at 05:17 p.m. IST. Limited review reports issued by statutory auditors M/s. Agarwal Maheswari & Co., Chartered Accountants, regarding the financial results are enclosed. The company requests the exchanges to take the information on record.
